name: zutil_zbd_section_handler_invoke_data_ready
description: zZbdSectionHandler::InvokeDataReady dispatches the optional ZAR section data-ready callback with the callback context, section token, payload buffer, payload size, and registered user data.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD/ZAR manager helper pass.
The callback ABI is verified functionally through the native smoke; no object-byte comparison was attempted in this session.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c06c0 validates the nullable onDataReady load from this+0x8, userData load from this+0x10, five-argument callback dispatch with callbackCtx in ECX, sectionToken in EDX, buffer/size/userData on the stack, and thiscall cleanup via retn 0x10.

The native smoke verifies the null-callback path is a no-op and that a registered fastcall data-ready callback receives the exact callback context, section token, payload buffer, payload size, and user-data pointer.
